propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled for the project, a warning must be emitted at save time (create or edit) stating the length, cap, and that claim will require a passing review.
The save-time warning must reuse the same config key and gate probe as the existing plan-review admission guard, ensuring a single source of truth and preventing promises the guard would not enforce.

The warning must be surfaced through three channels: CLI stderr, rebar logger (for library callers), and MCP result fields (description_warning on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut), without blocking or altering the ticket write.

The warning must not be emitted when the gate is disabled, when the description is within the cap, or for exempt ticket types, and must degrade gracefully to None on any error without affecting the write.
